Chat votes with !vote -10 to 10 (decimals OK, e.g. 7.5 · 0.5 · -3) or !vote hoomp — counted separately, never touches the average. !vote 0 = hate toast. Say hoomp anywhere in chat for the HOOMP moment.

Keys: D controls · P pause · E end · Shift+C clear · I island panel (Island layout only) · W wrestling overlay.
Wrestling controls live above under Wrestling — overlay visibility, episode, live merch, ticker. Accent recolors rater and stack together. Wrestling size: ?stack=0.5–2.5 (default 1). Wrestling overlay: ?wrestling=0 hides the stack. Head circle: ?phring=1 rings the Pete heads (default off). Chatbox: bottom-center, ?chatpos=bl|br moves it, ?chat=0 hides it. Bubbles stack over the collapsed island per message (?bubble=0 off). Positions (OBS has no drawer, so pin them in the URL): ?corner=br · ?pos=right · ?ipos=br.
This file defaults to ?channel=agoodpete — ?channel= still overrides. Stream source: agoodpete.html?channel=agoodpete&clean=1 (add &accent=… to carry the accent).
